Foundation/Architecture are supporting definition areas, not new registered components. No count inferred from directory/concern membership.

findings.criterion: Every new dependency assertion has a declared meaning, direction, contract and scope; same-Layer contracts are represented; allocation order is not a dependency graph. Consumer→provider, exact contract/scope, support order and lower/higher meaning explicit; all seven rows preserve Concepts §8 and expand Blueprint pairs. Same-Layer requirements retained; actual required cycles prohibited and not hidden by labels. No arbitrary upward exception or complete graph claimed.

Validation/generation/consistency identify exact inputs, rules, coverage, limits and provenance. New Layers/allocation/contracts require owner/consumer mapping and transition evidence. Compatibility preserved where feasible with justified incompatible changes under policy; actual V1.0→V2.0 normative reconciliation explained.
